about: the same manual run: there is no read to empty, and the ICP fields are the template's placeholders

branches: no IF/Switch; Split Out reads output.answer, which exists only if the agent's text output is an object (it is a string here, so Split Out is expected to fail or emit nothing; model-driven)
expect.offline: The workflow reads nothing and writes nothing: the ICP is the template's static placeholder text ('**Replace this with …**'), the agent answers from it, and Connect to your own database is a No Operation. All four variants therefore run on the same input; they exist so the bench has a row per variant. Anthropic Chat Model ships without a credential (the bench attaches the per-node model credential)
